cases.name: nested-data-maps
cases.description: nested data objects become nested Y.Maps at any depth; empty objects and null leaves survive

cases.name: keyed-grid
cases.description: arrays of arrays take the keyed __rows/__rowKeys shape; empty rows and [[],[]] stay grids; grids nest

cases.name: table-row-ids
cases.description: a grid row whose cells all carry one `rowId` is keyed by it; a row whose cells disagree, or an empty row, gets a minted key

cases.name: cell-block-ids
cases.description: a table cell's `blocks` id list is a Y.Array at every nesting depth, empty and all-string included, so concurrent inserts into one cell merge

cases.name: array-kinds
cases.description: convertible arrays (all objects) become Y.Arrays; primitive, mixed and empty arrays stay atomic leaves

cases.name: tunes
cases.description: tunes are emitted only when the Y.Map is non-empty; {} and absent both read back as absent

cases.name: hierarchy-3-deep
cases.description: flat order is DFS from root through contentIds, independent of input order

cases.name: cycle
cases.description: parent cycles: the smallest id keeps its parent, the rest go to root; a self-parent is always broken

cases.name: duplicate-id
cases.description: an id in two order arrays is emitted at its first PARENT-AGREEING occurrence; repeats in one array are kept

cases.name: orphans
cases.description: unreached blocks append in two sorted passes: tops (no parent entry) first, then the rest; sort is UTF-16 code-unit order

cases.name: dangling
cases.description: a parentId with no map entry is kept; a content id with no map entry is kept in content and skipped in order

cases.name: parent-null
cases.description: parent: null is written as a doc-side null, reads back as no parent, and is NOT in the root order (orphan tail)

cases.name: edit-metadata
cases.description: lastEditedAt survives only as a number, lastEditedBy only as a string

cases.name: paragraph-normalization
cases.description: an empty paragraph data {} becomes { text: "" }; other tools and non-empty paragraphs are untouched

cases.name: unicode-text
cases.description: non-ASCII text, emoji (incl. ZWJ sequences), combining marks, RTL and escapes in values, keys and ids

cases.name: content-string-code-points
cases.description: a string content spreads by code point (Y.Array.from): a surrogate pair is one entry, a combining sequence stays two

cases.name: database-rows
cases.description: arrays of plain objects (schema, views, options) are element-wise Y.Arrays, never grids; rows are child blocks

cases.name: grid-normalization
cases.description: doc-only: duplicated row key → first wins; key without a row → dropped; rows absent from the order → appended sorted by key

cases.name: legacy-bare-grid
cases.description: doc-only: a bare Y.Array of row Y.Arrays (pre-keyed docs) still reads back as rows

cases.name: empty-doc
cases.description: an empty block list seeds an empty doc

cases.name: malformed-blocks
cases.description: a non-string id is skipped entirely; non-string content entries and parents pass through the type checks

cases.name: proto-key

cases.name: lenient-seed
